documents.title: Hot Spring County 2026 budget, as filed with the state
documents.note: Posted on the Arkansas Transparency portal (artransparency.gov) in May 2026. 83 pages. Amounts are the 2026 column of the annual budget (category totals and grand totals); the 2025 column is not used column. The document is a scan; it was read with optical character recognition, and every parent total was checked against its parts.
